null: Exchangeable observed family from fitted global BDI+gamma+error model. Not a branch-specific no-change null.
pooling: CDF averages over all families per full simulated dataset. Dataset is the independent unit for MC standard errors.
family_statistic: Conditional log probability of complete observed tip pattern; lower tail.
branch_statistic: Primary: upper tail of posterior-category-weighted transition surprise at marginal-MAP parent/child counts. Sensitivity: doubled minimum tail of posterior mean change.
selection: All nonzero observed families; no size or root-state filtering.
MC_intervals: Approximate pointwise 95% Student-t intervals across independent simulated datasets; not simultaneous and not biological confidence intervals.
